claim_text: Through our recycling and reuse initiatives, we were able to meet 39% of our overall demand, while water extraction at KGP remained well below the licensed annual entitlement.
metric_name: Total water use; Reused water; Recycled water; withdrawn water
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The report states that recycling and reuse initiatives met 39% of overall water demand, while the disclosed KGP total withdrawn water of 3,563 ML remained below the approved annual entitlement of 5,000 ML.
llm_reason: The claim asserts that recycling and reuse met 39% of overall demand and water extraction was below licensed entitlement. The evidence provides specific volumes: recycled water (20 ML), reused water (2259 ML), and withdrawn water (3563 ML). Summing these components yields a total water use of 5842 ML, where recycled and reused water (2279 ML) constitutes exactly 39% (2279/5842 ≈ 0.39), substantively verifying the percentage claim. Additionally, the withdrawn water (3563 ML) is factually below the minimum licensed annual entitlement (4000 ML), verifying the second assertion. The evidence contains all factual elements necessary to verify the claim's numerical and comparative meanings.
